summary: Marco López 等发表论文，分析在出现能破解 secp256k1 的量子计算机时，EOA 授权、交易与签名流程如何迁移及会坏掉什么。jannikluhn 把 EIP-8105 通用协议内加密内存池提为 Hegotá 头号提案：交易在打包前保持加密，防止抢跑与三明治攻击。VitalikButerin 发文论述把预确认与 based Rollup 结合实现同步可组合。

items.topic: 账户：量子威胁下的 EOA 迁移
items.title: ethresear.ch：量子威胁下 EOA 的迁移策略，断点与开放问题
items.note: （Marcolopeez）21:18：论文聚焦执行层，即 EOA 授权、交易与签名流程，在出现能破解 secp256k1/ECDSA 的量子计算机时如何迁移，不涉及共识层。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Migration Strategies for EOAs under the Quantum Threat, breakages and open questions
items.note_en: (Marcolopeez), 21:18: the paper focuses on the execution layer, meaning EOA authorization, transactions and signature flows, and how they migrate once a quantum computer can break secp256k1 and ECDSA, leaving the consensus layer aside.
items.topic_en: Accounts: EOA migration under the quantum threat

items.topic: 交易隐私：EIP-8105 加密内存池
items.title: Magicians：Hegotá 头号提案 EIP-8105 通用协议内加密内存池（EEM）
items.note: （jannikluhn）18:24：作为可选的协议级功能，让用户提交在打包前保持加密的交易，防止抢跑、三明治攻击与实时审查。
items.title_en: Magicians: Hegotá headliner proposal EIP-8105 Universal Enshrined Encrypted Mempool (EEM)
items.note_en: (jannikluhn), 18:24: an optional protocol level feature letting users submit transactions that stay encrypted until included, protecting against frontrunning, sandwich attacks and real time censorship.
items.topic_en: Transaction privacy: the EIP-8105 encrypted mempool

items.title: ethresear.ch：结合预确认与 based Rollup 实现同步可组合
items.note: （vbuterin）14:58：对比由 L1 决定排序的 based Rollup 与由链下机制排序的 sequenced Rollup。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Combining preconfirmations with based rollups for synchronous composability
items.note_en: (vbuterin), 14:58: contrasts based rollups ordered by L1 with sequenced rollups ordered offchain.

summary_en: Marco López and coauthors published a paper on how EOA authorization, transactions and signature flows would migrate, and what breaks, once a quantum computer can break secp256k1. jannikluhn proposed EIP-8105, the universal enshrined encrypted mempool, as a Hegotá headliner: transactions stay encrypted until inclusion, blocking frontrunning and sandwiching. VitalikButerin wrote on combining preconfirmations with based rollups for synchronous composability.
